title: Fiber Optic Projects
summary: End-to-end fiber optic deployment — NLD backbones, FTTH/GPON, splicing, OTDR testing and commissioning across India.
highlights: 500+ km Optical Fiber Cable laid across India
FDP, FAT, ODF and joint-closure installation
details: Nexatel specialises in laying, splicing and certifying optical fiber networks for service providers, enterprises and public projects. From National Long Distance backbones to Fiber-to-the-Home networks across Kerala, our crews deliver low-loss, fully-tested infrastructure under engineering leadership with 25+ years of fiber expertise.

title: Telecom Infrastructure
summary: Civil-to-active telecom build-out — HDD, manual trenching, manhole construction, pole erection, ROW liaison and road restoration.
highlights: Horizontal Directional Drilling (HDD) for trenchless crossings
Manual trenching for congested & urban routes
Right-of-Way liaison with NHAI, PWD & local bodies
details: We deliver the civil and infrastructure backbone behind every telecom rollout. Our turnkey teams handle ROW applications, route surveys, HDD and manual trenching, manhole construction, pole erection and authority-compliant road restoration — keeping projects on schedule and on standard.

title: Network Cabling
summary: Structured cabling for enterprises, campuses and data centres — Cat6 / Cat6A / Cat7 copper, OM3/OM4 fiber, racks and patching.
highlights: Cat6, Cat6A and Cat7 horizontal cabling
Patch panels, ODFs and rack build-outs
Aerial and structured cabling for campuses
details: Forge a sturdy network foundation with our high-quality cabling solutions. From single-floor offices to multi-building campuses and Tier-III data centres, we design, supply and install structured cabling that's certified, labelled and documented for the full lifetime of the network.

title: CCTV Systems
summary: IP camera, NVR and surveillance system supply, installation and maintenance for commercial, industrial and public sites.
highlights: Perimeter, indoor and PTZ coverage design
details: Protect your assets with cutting-edge CCTV systems. We supply, install and maintain end-to-end surveillance infrastructure — from initial site survey and camera placement to NVR commissioning and 24x7 maintenance contracts that keep your security posture continuously online.

title: IT Hardware Supply
summary: Sourcing and supply of laptops, servers, networking gear, fiber optic products and audio-visual equipment from tier-1 OEMs.
highlights: Fiber optic cables, transceivers and patch panels
Annual rate contracts for enterprises & projects
details: Through long-standing OEM relationships, we offer competitive pricing on tier-1 IT hardware and fiber-optic products — backed by warranty registration, asset tagging and on-site delivery across India. Bulk and rate-contract pricing available for government and enterprise tenders.
